topic.title: Predictive Uncertainty and Calibration
topic.overview: Uncertainty estimation asks whether a model knows how reliable its prediction is. Methods include distributions over weights, ensembles, evidential outputs, normalizing flows, and possibility-based formulations. They differ in what uncertainty means and how much additional computation is required to estimate it.
topic.whyItMatters: A confident error under distribution shift can be more damaging than an acknowledged limitation. Useful uncertainty should support decisions about deferral, data collection, or human involvement, rather than merely producing a numerical confidence score.
topic.evolution: Earlier representatives model uncertainty in hidden variables and neural weights. Deep ensembles and dataset-shift evaluations become prominent in the late 2010s, followed by evidential and efficient single-model alternatives. Recent work revisits theoretical foundations and post-hoc estimation. The examples show continuing tradeoffs among calibration, interpretation, and cost rather than one universally superior uncertainty measure.
openQuestions: Which uncertainty estimates remain informative after the deployment distribution changes?
How should uncertainty be evaluated against the actual cost of downstream decisions?

papers.title: Position: Epistemic Uncertainty Estimation Methods are Fundamentally Incomplete
papers.tldr: The paper shows that unaccounted bias and omitted variance sources make widely used epistemic uncertainty estimates incomplete.

papers.title: Position: Predictive Uncertainty Is Not Enough — Joint Distribution for Full Uncertainty Representation
papers.tldr: The authors argue that joint input–output modeling is needed to represent domain, epistemic, and aleatoric uncertainty coherently.

papers.title: Possibilistic Predictive Uncertainty for Deep Learning
papers.tldr: DAPPr derives an efficient predictive uncertainty method from possibility theory and reports competitive or superior benchmark performance.

papers.title: Quantile-Free Uncertainty Quantification in Graph Neural Networks
papers.tldr: QpiGNN directly learns graph prediction intervals, reporting improved coverage and narrower widths without quantile inputs or post-processing.

papers.title: Reliable Confidence Alignment for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.tldr: RCA transfers reliable confidence from labeled examples to unlabeled data, helping preserve known-class performance while discovering new categories.

papers.title: Richer Bayesian Last Layers with Subsampled NTK Features
papers.tldr: Projected and subsampled NTK features enrich Bayesian last-layer uncertainty estimates while preserving inexpensive inference.

papers.title: Robust Human-AI Complementarity under Uncertainty
papers.tldr: The paper shows that negatively correlated human and AI prediction errors enable robust strategies that improve expected utility under information-quality uncertainty.

papers.title: Variational Routing: A Scalable Bayesian Framework for Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
papers.tldr: VMoER confines Bayesian uncertainty modeling to expert routing, improving calibration and robustness with less than 1% additional FLOPs.

papers.title: X-EviProbe: Post-hoc Parameter-Free Evidential Uncertainty Quantification for Frozen Graph Neural Networks
papers.tldr: X-EviProbe derives decomposable uncertainty estimates from frozen graph neural networks without retraining or additional neural components.
